title: Questionnaire-based evaluation of quality of life in patients with medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw
summary:
Medication- related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) is a serious complication of bisphosphonate therapy and monoclonal antibodies, such as denosumab, which can significantly limit patients' (oral) quality of life.
This clinical study aims to investigate the extent to which standard surgical therapy in Germany changes the quality of life of patients with MRONJ and which parameters influence the quality of life the most.
Potential study participants are all patients of the „Kiefergesundheits-Sprechstunde“ at the „Klinik und Poliklinik für Mund-, Kiefer- und Plastische Gesichtschirurgie am Universitätsklinikum Bonn“ with a diagnosed MRONJ who fulfill the inclusion criteria and agree to participate in the study.
conditions: Other more specific inflammatory conditions of the jaw

interventions.name: Patients with medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw are interviewed with the questionnaires OHP-G53 and MRONJ-QoL ( two interview times: pre- & postoperative)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Ability to consent and written consent to participate in the study
- Diagnosed MRONJ
-Consent to surgical therapy
-Ability to meet the requirements of the study
Exclusion criteria:
-Lack of consent
-Recurrence or new lesion after surgery
-dementia patients or patients with other cognitive impairments who are unable to consent to the study
- Patients who do not agree to participate in the study for other reasons.
